notes: CDER Office of Compounding Quality and Compliance website-review letter (no facility inspection), near-identical in template to the NativeMed letter: misbranding under 502(a)/502(bb) for falsely suggesting HydraMed is the compounder of pictured semaglutide/tirzepatide products and for calling the sourcing pharmacy 'FDA-approved,' a designation FDA does not grant to compounders. The FEI identifies the website's associated establishment rather than an inspected facility, so location_contains is null per the no-inspection rule. is_sterile_product is set false to match the NativeMed precedent for this same letter template.
